services.name: Private Charter Aboard Sam Patch

services.name: Erie Canal Lock 32 Cruise Aboard Sam Patch
services.desc: Duration 75 min to 2hrs About Travel the routes of America’s early settlers and enjoy an authentic canal cruising experience! While aboard you will learn about the historical significance of the Erie Canal and how Lock 32 works with a live narrative. Relax and experience the natural beauty. Board at our dock location at 12 Schoen Place in the historic village of Pittsford, NY. Beer, wine, soft drinks, and snacks are available onboard for purchase. Per current U.S. Coast Guard regulations, infants ages three and under are free, but must be ticketed. Choose your type of cruise: 75 Minute Kid's All Ages • 90 minutes• Join us on Sam Patch to experience the historic Eric Canal & lock system

services.name: Scenic River and Canal Cruise Aboard Riverie
services.desc: Duration 1.5 to 2 hrs About Travel the routes of America’s early settlers and enjoy an authentic river & canal cruising experience! Board at our dock location at 280 Exchange Blvd in Corn Hill Landing in Rochester, NY. Beer, wine, soft drinks, and snacks are available onboard for purchase. Wildlife abounds along the Genesee River and Erie Canal, come see for yourself! We will also travel south along the Genesee River to where the river meets the Erie Canal. As we make our way back to Port, get your cameras ready for beautiful city skyline images from the water. Per current U.S. Coast Guard All Ages • 90 minutes • Join us aboard Riverie to experience the Genesee River & Erie Canal

checkin: Thank you for booking your cruise with Rochester By Water. You’re joining the hundreds of thousands of people from around the world who have experienced the Erie Canal and/or Genesee River.
cancellation: Rochester By Water is a small nonprofit organization, and ticket sales play a vital role in supporting our mission to share Rochester’s incredible waterways with as many people as possible. We are happy to issue a refund or transfer your ticket to another cruise if you notify us by phone or email more than 24 hours prior to your scheduled departure.
policies: Refunds or switches available if notified more than 24 hours before departure
No refunds or credits for cancellations within 24 hours
Cruises operate rain or shine unless captain cancels for safety
We are not able to refund or provide credits for lunch orders within 24 hours of the scheduled cruise time.
Occasionally, it’s necessary to cancel a scheduled cruise due to inclement weather or for emergency vessel repairs.
In these cases, we’ll work with you to reschedule your cruise, issue a credit for a future trip, or process a refund.
The patio would be included with any rental of the space as well, weather permitting.
On rare occasions, a cruise may be canceled due to inclement weather or emergency vessel repairs.
